audit: Dreamville Master System-Wide Audit (AUDIT → VERIFY → FIX → REGRESSION → 125-TURN INTEGRATION → RELEASE GATE)
runClass: CONTROLLED DETERMINISTIC/MOCK — no external AI credentials available in the audit environment; all integration evidence derives from deterministic mock adapters through the REAL application pipeline (HTTP POST /api/game/action). Canonical correctness, budgets, failure handling, persistence and idempotency are fully exercised; real-model prose quality is NOT claimed.

segments.recovery: REAL provider hang verified (2 sequential ~7s per-attempt budgets); bounded recovery
hostile DELETE_PLAYER proposal rejected by turn-package validation; player/location/inventory intact
registered adapters serving again; event ledger progressing

rigNotes: Injections are armed on BOTH registered adapters: provider failures trip lingering selection degradation, so a single-adapter injection can be silently skipped.
Every injected segment asserts delivery via adapter callHistory; the timeout segment additionally asserts a real hang (latency >= 5s), so no segment can pass vacuously.

Transient failures (429/5XX/timeout) set exponential cooldowns (5s->60s, recordProviderFailure) that deliberately outlive updateModelHealth('Healthy'); the rig waits them out and requires a registered-adapter warm-up before the next injection.

regression.method: 189 test files batched into 8 groups (tsx --test per batch, exit status captured; full npm test exceeds the audit environment's 180s execution window)
reruns: batch4 re-run after config-hygiene fix and prod-config restore to guarantee all batches ran in the final tree state

fixesThisSession.change: Chaos harness with per-mode delivery assertions (adapter callHistory), real-hang latency floor for the timeout mode, both-adapter arming, and cooldown-aware recovery between segments.

Source-pattern assertion expected the historical O(n) form `repo.getCanonicalCommandEvents(storyId).length + 1`; the F4 fix legitimately replaced it with the equivalent O(1) accessor `repo.getCanonicalCommandEventCount(storyId) + 1`. Regex now accepts both ledger-derived forms; the real guard (no process-global `++this.totalTurnsExecuted` counter) is unchanged.
fixesThisSession.justification: Both expressions derive turn identity from the canonical event ledger; neither is wall-clock or process-global entropy. The O(1) accessor is the F4 fix's own contract.

fixesThisSession.change: Both suites' beforeEach/afterEach unconditionally unlinkSync'd the tracked server/data/orchestrator_config_test.json fixture — deleting a repo-tracked file on every run (this is how the fixture was found missing at audit start). Replaced with snapshot-in-beforeEach / restore-in-afterEach: tests keep their clean-slate isolation, the tracked fixture survives.
fixesThisSession.verification: After re-running both suites plus full batches 1/2/4: `git status server/data/` clean; fixture present and byte-identical to HEAD.

fixesThisSession.change: A diagnostic probe script executed OUTSIDE the test runtime (no NODE_TEST_CONTEXT) persisted its mock-model pins into the PRODUCTION orchestrator_config.json, breaking tests/current-free-model-routing-policy.test.ts (3 failures: unexpected primary, missing groq continuity fallback, non-adapter-addressable entries). Restored to HEAD via git checkout. The diagnostic script was removed. Key learning: any script that constructs MultiModelOrchestrator outside node:test writes to the prod config; the marathon/chaos rigs are safe because node:test sets the test-config path.
fixesThisSession.prevention: orchestrator_config.json + orchestrator_config_test.json restored to HEAD and verified clean after full regression (grep for mock-model names returns 0 matches).

documentedFindings.severity: MEDIUM (product behavior; NOT a regression; identical at HEAD 91eeaf8)
documentedFindings.finding: The item-use classifier regex /\b(use|consume|drink|eat|apply|read|activate)\b/i matches 'read' inside the benign word 'Re-read'. With no inventory-item name in the probe text, this yields unknownUseTarget:true -> NOVEL_CAPABILITY strategy (aiCallPolicy.ts:139-145) -> emergency synthesizer invents a capability -> CHARACTER_INCOMPATIBLE -> 409 CAPABILITY_SIMULATION_BLOCKED on benign text.
documentedFindings.decision: Documented, not changed: weakening server assertions to make harness probes pass was out of scope and risky this session; the marathon leak-probe contract already accepts 409-or-200 (deny-or-narrate). Harness probe texts were reworded instead.
documentedFindings.recommendedFix: Require an inventory-item name match (or possessive context) before setting unknownUseTarget, or drop 'read' from the capability-suggesting verb list when no readable item exists.

documentedFindings.finding: The original marathon harness executed 4-5 pipeline actions per numbered turn (~470 actions mislabeled as turns); full runs needed 280-350s — physically impossible in the 180s execution window, so the marathon had NEVER completed in any prior run. The rewritten harness executes exactly one action per turn; run7 completed 125 turns in 58.7s.

workspaceIntegrity.verification: git status server/data/ clean after full regression; workstation_ledger.json modification untouched throughout.
